title: Listening Drill — Orchard tour
description: Booking dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Orchard tour
sections.transcript:
CALLER: Hello. I'd like to book a guided orchard tour. I saw an older notice saying that bookings opened on Wednesday morning. Is that still right?

ADVISER: That notice is out of date. Bookings open on Thursday this time. If you collect your booking pack in person, go to the farm shop. The reception desk in the main building won't have the packs.

CALLER: How much is the booking? I can pay online if that saves time.

ADVISER: The total is twelve pounds. Pay once you've checked the date. Then contact Maya if you haven't received confirmation within two working days.

CALLER: Thanks. Is there anything else I should know before I arrive?

ADVISER: One practical detail: the path is muddy after rain.
